package.name: vamp
package.description: VAMP (Vector-Accelerated Motion Planning) packaged as a ROS 2 ament_cmake library for the Sentinel path-planning stack. Header-only SIMD planning + collision checking, plus the vendored simdxorshift RNG as a static library. This is the Rocketfarm `ros2` branch of the KavrakiLab/vamp fork — see ROS2_PACKAGE.md for the branch contract and sync procedure.
